title: Furniture Website
summary: I’m excited to share my work on a Furniture Website designed to showcase beautiful furniture collections and provide a smooth shopping experience for users. The goal was to create a website that is easy to use, visually appealing, and fully functional across all devices.
features: Responsive Design: Works perfectly on desktops, tablets, and phones.
Product Display: Showcases furniture collections with high-quality images.
Online Inquiry Form: A simple way for customers to ask questions or request details.
Easy Navigation: Simple, clean layout for easy browsing.
SEO Optimization: Helps the website rank higher on search engines.
challenges: Design Consistency: I created a design guide in Figma to ensure fonts, colors, and layout stayed consistent on every page.
Loading Speed: I optimized image sizes using Photoshop and added caching plugins to make the website faster.
User Experience: I tested the website on multiple devices to ensure smooth browsing for all users.
outcome: The final result is a modern, user-friendly, and responsive website that makes it easy for users to explore and inquire about furniture products. This project gave me the chance to showcase my skills in UI design, website development, and problem-solving.
